exampleSentence: Add a teaspoon of sugar to the batter.
exampleTranslation: 往面糊里加一茶匙糖。

exampleSentence: A technician repaired the laboratory equipment.
exampleTranslation: 一名技术员修理了实验室设备。

exampleSentence: The pianist spent months mastering the difficult technique.
exampleTranslation: 这位钢琴家花了几个月掌握这项困难的技巧。

exampleSentence: New technology has changed the way we work.
exampleTranslation: 新技术改变了我们的工作方式。

exampleSentence: Many teens spend several hours online every day.
exampleTranslation: 许多青少年每天上网好几个小时。

exampleSentence: The teenager volunteered at the animal shelter every Saturday.
exampleTranslation: 那个青少年每周六都在动物收容所做志愿者。

exampleSentence: She sent a telegram to announce the birth of her son.
exampleTranslation: 她发了一封电报，宣布儿子出生的消息。

exampleSentence: Before telephones, people used the telegraph to send urgent news.
exampleTranslation: 在电话出现之前，人们用电报发送紧急消息。

exampleSentence: She answered the telephone on the first ring.
exampleTranslation: 电话铃一响，她就接了起来。

exampleSentence: We used a telescope to observe the moon.
exampleTranslation: 我们用望远镜观察月球。

exampleSentence: The children watched a nature program on television.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们在电视上看了一个自然节目。

exampleSentence: The company sent the order by telex before email became common.
exampleTranslation: 在电子邮件普及之前，公司通过电传发出了订单。

exampleSentence: Please tell me when the next train leaves.
exampleTranslation: 请告诉我下一班火车什么时候出发。

exampleSentence: He lost his temper when the train was cancelled again.
exampleTranslation: 火车再次取消时，他发脾气了。

exampleSentence: Her calm temperament makes her a good negotiator.
exampleTranslation: 她性情沉稳，因此能成为优秀的谈判者。

exampleSentence: The temperature dropped below freezing last night.
exampleTranslation: 昨晚气温降到了冰点以下。

exampleSentence: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.
exampleTranslation: 我们参观了山里的一座古寺。

exampleSentence: The music slowed to a gentle tempo.
exampleTranslation: 音乐放慢到舒缓的节奏。

exampleSentence: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to stop at the bakery.
exampleTranslation: 新鲜面包的香味诱使我在面包店停了下来。

exampleSentence: She resisted the temptation to check her phone during dinner.
exampleTranslation: 晚餐时，她抵制住了查看手机的诱惑。

exampleSentence: There are ten chairs around the table.
exampleTranslation: 桌子周围有十把椅子。

exampleSentence: The tenant pays rent on the first day of each month.
exampleTranslation: 租户在每月第一天支付房租。

exampleSentence: People tend to forget names they have just heard.
exampleTranslation: 人们往往会忘记刚刚听到的名字。

exampleSentence: He has a tendency to speak too quickly when nervous.
exampleTranslation: 他紧张时往往说得太快。

exampleSentence: The tension in the room eased after everyone laughed.
exampleTranslation: 大家笑起来之后，房间里的紧张气氛缓和了。
